ActorTalk: This mural, inscribed with "the Great Evacuation", serves as both a memorial and a warning.

In memory of everyone who fought valiantly in the mission, and to honor the brilliance of the human will. This serves to remind F.O.S. students never to forget the sorrow of that day, and to remind F.O.S. students that they should always march on with courage.
(Observe a moment of silence as before.)
May peace be with every child of Earth.
